app-queue.why: The layout effect sets window.App.checkout and flushes the Array App.q, then swaps it for a run-immediately push, as the message describes, and the inline script is left unchanged.

prefill-semantics.why: prefill still only fills fields where `!el.value`, the draft restore runs before the queued flush in the same effect, and the namedItem vs form[k] difference is flagged.

no-card-draft.why: onBeforeUnload saves only email and country to sessionStorage, with the comment 'never the card number'.

double-submit.why: Button is disabled via submitting state, setSubmitting(false) on a non-ok response, and sessionStorage.removeItem(DRAFT) on success; the async-state timing difference is flagged.

tracking-event.why: onSubmit still calls document.dispatchEvent(new Event('checkout:submit')) and tracking.js is left in place.

no-silent-changes.why: The summary calls out the changed mounting, state-based button disabling, namedItem lookup, Strict Mode guard, the Vite build requirement, and the preserved quirks.
